info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_ATM Network Insights API
info.description: The ATM Network Insights API provides access to vital information regarding the management of ATM networks. Through this API, users can retrieve important details about specific ATM channels, enhancing operational visibility and decision-making. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions and service operators looking to optimize their ATM networks. This endpoint streamlines the process of monitoring and managing ATM performance, ensuring efficient service delivery to customers.

get.summary: Retrieve ATM network management details for a specific resource.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch the details of the ATM network management for the resource identified by RES-100045. It is essential for monitoring and managing ATM networks efficiently.
